title.zh: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
title.en: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027

current_state.zh: The European Securities and Markets Authority will make AI and tokenization the first focus of a new EU-wide supervisory priority starting in 2027, with national regulators mapping client-facing uses, conducting spot checks on affected firms, and developing common oversight approaches.
current_state.en: The European Securities and Markets Authority will make AI and tokenization the first focus of a new EU-wide supervisory priority starting in 2027, with national regulators mapping client-facing uses, conducting spot checks on affected firms, and developing common oversight approaches.
